title: DKG Integration Registry Entry
description: A single integration listed in the official DKG integrations registry. Entries live in integrations/<slug>.json in this repo and are consumed by `dkg integration` CLI/UI surfaces to discover, install, and manage integrations built on top of DKG v10 public interfaces.

$schema.description: Editor-tooling hint. Not enforced by the registry; contributors may point it at the local schema file or the canonical URL.

schemaVersion.description: Which version of this JSON Schema the entry targets. Semver.

slug.description: URL-safe, globally unique integration identifier. Must match the registry normalization rule: lowercase, ASCII-only, hyphen-separated, stopwords stripped (the/a/an/of/for/and/or/to/in/on/with), length 3-60. The filename must be integrations/<slug>.json.

name.description: Human-readable integration name shown in `dkg integration search` and the dashboard.

description.description: One- or two-sentence blurb shown in listings. Plain prose, no marketing.

category.description: Free-text tags for filtering in search. Keep short and lowercase.

maintainer.description: Who is responsible for this integration. Required: a GitHub handle or team.

github.description: GitHub user or team handle, e.g. @brana or @OriginTrail/core-developers.

contact.description: Email, Discord handle, or other contact (optional).

repo.description: HTTPS URL of the integration's source repository.

commit.description: Full 40-character git SHA the registry entry pins to. Updates require a new registry PR.

license.description: SPDX license identifier (must match the LICENSE file in the pinned commit).

requiresDkgNodeVersion.description: Semver range the DKG node must satisfy for this integration. Example: '>=10.0.0'.

memoryLayers.description: Which memory layers the integration touches.

v10PrimitivesUsed.description: Which v10 primitives the integration exercises. Helps the committee assess faithfulness to the model.

publicInterfacesUsed.description: Which supported public interfaces the integration CONSUMES from the local DKG node (independent of how the integration itself is distributed). Values: 'http-api' (calls /api/... endpoints), 'cli' (shells out to the `dkg` binary), 'mcp' (consumes the DKG MCP server as a client). An integration that IS an MCP server but talks to the node over HTTP should list only 'http-api' here — what it exposes to its own clients is captured by `install.kind`. Anything outside this list is a scope violation (see bounty doc Section 5).

targetAgents.description: Which agent frameworks or clients the integration targets.

install.description: How `dkg integration install <slug>` should materialize this integration. Exactly one kind.

security.description: Security declarations. CI cross-checks a subset against the published package; the rest is authoritative prose for the review committee.

networkEgress.description: Every external host (beyond the local DKG node) the integration contacts. Use '*' only with justification in notes.

writeAuthority.description: Every DKG endpoint or CLI command the integration invokes that mutates state. Curator-authority ops (PUBLISH, SHARE) must appear here if used.

credentialsHandled.description: Third-party credentials the integration asks the user to provide (e.g. SLACK_BOT_TOKEN). Do NOT list the DKG auth token here; it is handled by the installer.

trustTier.description: Assigned by the review committee. Contributors submit as 'community'; the committee may upgrade.

designBrief.description: URL of the design brief Markdown document (bounty doc Section 8).

demo.description: URL of a recorded walkthrough or live endpoint (bounty doc Section 8).

promotionPath.description: How Working/Shared artifacts mature toward Verified Memory and downstream oracle consumption (bounty doc Section 9, criterion 4). Prose, 1-4 sentences.

fitNotes.description: Optional prose on LLM-Wiki / autoresearch fit.

envRequired.description: Environment variables the MCP server expects. DKG_AUTH_TOKEN and DKG_API_URL are auto-filled by the installer if listed; others prompt the user.

digest.description: Optional image digest. Strongly recommended for verified/featured tier.

binary.description: The CLI binary name shipped by this package, if different from the package name.

installCli.description: A CLI tool installed globally and invoked on demand by the operator. Intended for ad-hoc, one-shot integrations (demos, templates, utilities).

usageHint.description: Short post-install message showing the operator how to invoke the CLI.
